_what: Hand-written descriptions for server cvars, merged into ui/data/ql_cvar_catalog.json by scripts/gen_cvar_catalog.py.
_format: "<cvar>": ["<description>", "<source tag>"] - the source tag is shown in the editor next to the description, so a reader can tell how much the wording is worth.

_source_tags.ql-live: Documented and verified in the ql-live knowledge base (console commands, voting, cvar metadata) of the alexeytihomirov/ql monorepo.
_source_tags.factories: Behaviour visible in the game's own scripts/factories.txt (which official factory sets it, and to what).
_source_tags.naming: Read off the cvar name and its weapon/ammo suffix. Not observed on a live server - treat as a hint, not a fact.
_source_tags.qlsm: Set or overwritten by this app.
_source_tags.null: No description: the name comes from a listcvars dump and nothing else about it is verified.

timelimit: Match length in minutes; 0 means no time limit. Normally set by the factory or a callvote rather than by hand.
fraglimit: Frags needed to win the match; 0 means no frag limit.
capturelimit: Flag captures needed to win a CTF-style match.
roundlimit: Rounds needed to win a round-based match (CA, Freeze Tag, Red Rover).
roundtimelimit: Length of a single round in seconds.
scorelimit: Score needed to win in gametypes scored by points rather than frags (Domination, Harvester).
mercylimit: Score lead at which the match ends early by mercy rule; 0 disables it.
teamsize: Players allowed per team. The teamsize callvote and !teamsize change this.
dmflags: Deathmatch flags bitmask inherited from Quake 3. The official Clan Arena factories set 28; the meaning of the individual bits is not verified for Quake Live.
mapname: Map currently running. Status value written by the engine.
nextmap: Command the server runs when the current match ends. Written by the engine and by map votes.
nextmaps: Upcoming maps the engine picked from the map pool.
armor_tiered: Tiered armour system (green/yellow/red absorb differently) on or off.
dedicated: Dedicated server mode: 0 = listen server, 1 = LAN, 2 = internet. Normally set on the command line at launch.
developer: Extra engine debug output in the console.
logfile: Console logging: 0 = off, 1 = buffered, 2 = flush after every line.
appendlogfile: Append to the existing console log instead of overwriting it at startup.
serverstartup: Command the engine runs once it has finished initializing, for example "map campgrounds ffa" or "startRandomMap". On a managed instance this is the only reliable way to pick the starting map - a bare map line in server.cfg loses.
g_gametype: Gametype ID of the running match (0 = FFA, 3 = TDM, 4 = CA, 5 = CTF and so on). On a dedicated server this comes from the factory the map was started with, not from server.cfg.
g_factory: ID of the factory the current match was started with.
g_factoryTitle: Display title of the current factory.
g_doWarmup: Run a warmup period before the match starts.
g_warmup: Warmup length in seconds when g_doWarmup is on.
g_roundWarmupDelay: Milliseconds of warmup between rounds in round-based gametypes.
g_overtime: Overtime length in minutes when a match ends in a draw; 0 disables overtime.
g_timeoutCount: Timeouts each team may call per match.
g_timeoutLen: Length of a single timeout in seconds.
g_allowForfeit: Allow a team to forfeit the match.
g_allowKill: Allow players to use the kill command to suicide.
g_mercytime: Seconds of a large score lead before the mercy rule ends the match.
g_restarted: Set by the engine while a map_restart is in progress.
g_levelStartTime: Server time the current level started. Status value.
g_gameState: Current match state as reported by the engine.
g_skipTrainingEnable: Let players skip the training intro.
g_motd: Message of the day shown to connecting players.
g_logSync: Flush the game log after every line instead of buffering it.
g_needpass: Written by the engine to tell clients a password is required. Set g_password instead.
g_autoAction: Bitmask for automatic per-match actions such as demo recording and screenshots.
g_customSettings: Marks the match as running non-default settings.
g_teamAutoJoin: Put connecting players straight onto a team instead of into spectators.
g_teamForceBalance: Stop players from joining the team that already has more players.
g_teamForcePresent: Require players to be present in the game before the match starts.
g_teamSizeMin: Smallest team size the server will run a match with.
g_teamSpawnAsSpec: Put players into spectators when they join a team game.
g_teamSpecSayEnable: Let spectators chat to players on their team.
g_switchTeamDelay: Delay before a player may switch teams again.
g_inactivityWarning: Seconds of warning before the g_inactivity kick fires.
g_kickBadUserinfo: Kick clients that send malformed userinfo.
g_complaintLimit: Complaints against a player before action is taken.
g_complaintDamageThreshold: Team damage needed before a complaint counts.
g_banIPs: IP addresses banned from the server.
g_filterBan: Apply the IP ban filter to connecting players.
g_allowCustomHeadmodels: Allow custom head models on player models.
g_playermodelOverride: Force every player to use this player model.
g_playerheadmodelOverride: Force every player to use this head model.
g_playerModelScale: Scale factor applied to player models.
g_playerheadScale: Scale factor applied to player head models.
g_playerheadScaleOffset: Offset applied on top of the head model scale.
g_playerCylinders: Use cylinder-shaped player hitboxes instead of boxes.
g_shuffle_automatic: Shuffle teams automatically when they look unbalanced.
g_shuffle_automatic_minplayers: Players needed before an automatic shuffle may happen.
g_shuffle_minplayers: Players needed before a shuffle vote is allowed.
g_shuffle_timedelay: Delay before a shuffle takes effect.
g_respawn_delay_min: Lower bound in milliseconds on the respawn delay after a player dies. The official race and vca factories set 500.
g_respawn_delay_max: Upper bound in milliseconds on the respawn delay after a player dies. The official race and vca factories set 3500.
g_enemyTeamRespawnRatio: Scales the respawn delay by how many enemies are still alive.
g_maxDeferredSpawns: How many spawns the server may defer before forcing them.
g_spawnMinDistance: Minimum distance a spawn point must be from other players.
g_spawnRandomRatio: How much randomness goes into spawn point selection.
g_spawnArmorDmgScale: Damage scaling applied while spawn armour lasts.
g_spawnDelay_key: Delay in milliseconds before a key item respawns.
g_spawnDelay_powerup: Delay in milliseconds before a powerup respawns.
g_spawnDelayRandom_key: Random extra delay added to key item respawns.
g_spawnDelayRandom_powerup: Random extra delay added to powerup respawns.
g_spawnItemAmmo: Ammo items are spawned on the map.
g_spawnItemArmor: Armour items are spawned on the map.
g_spawnItemHealth: Health items are spawned on the map.
g_spawnItemHoldable: Holdable items (teleporter, medkit) are spawned on the map.
g_spawnItemPowerup: Powerups (quad, regen, battle suit) are spawned on the map.
g_spawnItemWeapons: Weapon pickups are spawned on the map. The official dom factory sets it to 0, so players keep only their spawn loadout.
g_grantItemOnSpawn: Item granted to a player every time they spawn.
g_weaponRespawn: Seconds before a picked-up weapon reappears.
g_ammoRespawn: Seconds before a picked-up ammo box reappears.
g_powerupRespawn: Seconds before a picked-up powerup reappears.
g_itemTimers: Show item respawn timers to players. The timers callvote (g_voteFlags bit 8192) toggles the same thing.
g_specItemTimers: Show item respawn timers to spectators.
g_itemHeight: Height items float at above the floor.
g_dropPowerups: Players drop their powerups when killed.
g_droppedPowerupsDecay: Seconds before a dropped powerup disappears.
g_dropCmds: Bitmask of what players may drop with the drop command.
g_startingHealthBonus: Extra health on top of g_startingHealth that decays back down over time.
g_startingWeapons: Bitmask of the weapons a player spawns with. The official ca factory uses 8447, which is every weapon up to the plasma gun plus the heavy machine gun (bit 8192) - dropping that bit is how a factory takes the HMG away.
g_bestStartingWeapons: Weapon preference order used when picking the best weapon to spawn with.
g_infiniteAmmo: Weapons never run out of ammo.
g_instaGib: Instagib mode: railgun only, one shot kills.
g_disableLoadout: Turn the loadout system off entirely.
g_runes: Rune pickups (Scout, Guard, Doubler, Ammo Regen) enabled.
g_quadDamageFactor: Damage multiplier the Quad Damage powerup applies.
g_quadHog: Quad Hog mode: one quad drives the whole match.
g_quadHogIdle: Seconds an untouched Quad Hog quad waits before it moves.
g_quadHogTime: How long a Quad Hog quad lasts.
g_quadHogPingRate: How often the Quad Hog quad position is announced.
g_regenArmorAfterHealth: Only start regenerating armour once health is full.
g_vampiricDamage: Fraction of the damage dealt that comes back to the attacker as health.
g_battleSuitDampen: Damage reduction the Battle Suit applies.
g_gravity: World gravity. 800 is the Quake Live default.
g_knockback: Global knockback multiplier applied to damage.
g_max_knockback: Upper limit on knockback from a single hit.
g_knockback_z_self: Vertical component of knockback from your own weapon.
g_knockback_cripple: Knockback applied to a crippled (heavily damaged) player.
g_friendlyFireDampen: Scaling applied to friendly fire damage.
g_damagePlums: Show floating damage numbers on hits.
g_railJump: Railgun shots push the shooter (rail jumping).
g_guidedRocket: Rockets can be steered after firing.
g_gauntletSpeedFactor: Speed boost while holding the gauntlet.
g_midAirMinHeight: Minimum height a target must be at for a mid-air award.
g_nailbouncepercentage: How much velocity a nail keeps after bouncing.
g_nailspread: Spread of the nailgun shot pattern.
g_proxMineTimeout: Milliseconds before a proximity mine expires.
g_kamiMinRatio: Minimum damage ratio the Kamikaze deals at the edge of its blast.
g_rocketsplashOffset: Offset applied to rocket splash damage origin.
g_splashdamageOffset: Offset applied to splash damage origin.
g_lagHaxMs: Milliseconds of lag compensation (unlagged) the server applies.
g_lagHaxHistory: How many past frames the server keeps for lag compensation.
g_forceDmgThroughSurface: Force damage to pass through thin surfaces.
g_dmgThroughSurfaceDistance: Maximum distance damage may travel through a surface.
g_dmgThroughSurfaceDampening: Damage reduction applied when damage passes through a surface.
g_dmgThroughSurfaceAngularThreshold: Angle limit for damage passing through a surface.
g_forceAtmosphericEffects: Force atmospheric effects (rain, snow) on all clients.
g_forceSendConfigstring: Force configstrings to be resent to clients.
g_lastManStandingMessage: Announce when one player is left alive.
g_podiumDist: Camera distance from the end-of-match podium.
g_podiumDrop: Camera drop for the end-of-match podium.
g_roundDrawHealthCount: Health tie-break used when a round ends in a draw.
g_roundDrawLivingCount: Living-player tie-break used when a round ends in a draw.
g_suddenDeathRespawnIncrement: Step by which the sudden-death respawn delay grows.
g_suddenDeathRespawnMax: Upper limit of the sudden-death respawn delay.
g_suddenDeathRespawnTick: Tick interval of the sudden-death respawn timer.
g_freezeAutoThawTime: Milliseconds before a frozen player thaws on their own.
g_freezeThawTime: Milliseconds a team-mate needs to stand in the thaw radius.
g_freezeThawRadius: Radius in units within which a frozen player can be thawed.
g_freezeThawTick: Tick interval of the thaw timer.
g_freezeThawWinningTeam: Thawing rules for the winning team.
g_freezeProtectedSpawnTime: Spawn protection time in Freeze Tag.
g_freezeEnvironmentalRespawnDelay: Respawn delay after an environmental death in Freeze Tag.
g_freezeRemovePowerupsOnRound: Remove powerups at the start of each round.
g_freezeResetArmorOnRound: Reset armour at the start of each round.
g_freezeResetHealthOnRound: Reset health at the start of each round.
g_freezeResetWeaponsOnRound: Reset weapons at the start of each round.
g_domCapTime: Seconds needed to capture a Domination point.
g_domScoreRate: How fast a held Domination point scores.
g_domDistressThreshold: Threshold at which a Domination point counts as under attack.
g_domTeammateCapScale: Capture speed scaling when several team-mates capture together.
g_adCaptureScoreBonus: Score bonus for capturing in Attack and Defend.
g_adElimScoreBonus: Score bonus for an elimination in Attack and Defend.
g_adTouchScoreBonus: Score bonus for touching the objective in Attack and Defend.
g_obeliskRegenAmount: Health the obelisk regenerates per step.
g_obeliskRespawnDelay: Delay before a destroyed obelisk comes back.
g_flagPhysics: Physics model used by dropped flags.
g_droppedFlagBonus: Score bonus for returning a dropped flag.
g_returnFlagOnSuicide: Return the flag when its carrier suicides.
g_neutralFlagPingRate: How often the neutral flag position is announced (One Flag CTF).
g_throwFlagForwardMult: Forward multiplier applied to a thrown flag.
g_cubeTimeout: Seconds before a Harvester skull cube expires.
g_rrInfected: Red Rover infection mode on or off.
g_rrInfectedZombieHealthBonus: Extra health given to a zombie.
g_rrInfectedZombieFragBonus: Frags awarded for a zombie kill.
g_rrInfectedSurvivorMinSpeed: Minimum speed a survivor must keep.
g_rrInfectedSurvivorPingRate: How often survivor positions are announced.
g_rrRoundScoreBonus: Score bonus at the end of a Red Rover round.
g_rrDamageScoreBonus: Score bonus for damage dealt in Red Rover.
g_rrDeathScorePenalty: Score penalty for dying in Red Rover.
g_rrAllowNegativeScores: Allow scores to go below zero in Red Rover.
g_latchedHookOffset: Offset applied to a latched grappling hook.
sv_hostname: Server name shown in the server browser and in the client's connect screen.
sv_pure: Pure server: clients may only use pak files the server references.
sv_cheats: Cheats flag. devmap sets it indirectly.
sv_maxclients: How many clients can be connected at once (players plus spectators).
sv_mapname: Map the server is currently running.
sv_timeout: Seconds without packets before a client is dropped.
sv_zombietime: Seconds a dropped client stays in a zombie state before its slot is freed.
sv_reconnectlimit: Seconds a kicked client must wait before reconnecting.
sv_strictAuth: Require Steam authentication for connecting clients.
sv_vac: VAC (Valve Anti-Cheat) state for this server.
sv_lanForceRate: Force LAN rates for connected clients.
sv_running: Set by the engine while a server is running.
sv_killserver: Setting this to 1 makes the engine unload the current server.
sv_quitOnEmpty: Quit the process once the last player leaves.
sv_quitOnExitLevel: Quit the process when the level ends.
sv_idleRestart: Restart the server when it has been idle.
sv_errorExit: Exit the process on a fatal server error.
sv_showloss: Log packet loss for connected clients.
sv_padPackets: Add padding bytes to network packets (debugging).
sv_workshopFile: Steam Workshop manifest file the server loads maps from.
sv_includeCurrentMapInVote: Offer the current map in the map vote list.
sv_dumpEntities: Dump the map entity list to a file.
sv_serverid: Server ID written by the engine.
sv_gtid: Gametype ID reported by the engine.
sv_pakNames: Names of the pak files the server has loaded.
sv_paks: Checksums of the pak files the server has loaded.
sv_referencedPakNames: Names of the pak files clients must have.
sv_referencedPaks: Checksums of the pak files clients must have.
sv_referencedSteamworks: Steam Workshop items clients must have.
sv_altEntDir: Alternative directory the server loads map entity overrides from.
net_qport: Client port number used to tell connections apart behind NAT.
com_maxfps: Frame rate cap for the process.
com_idleSleep: Sleep when idle to give CPU time back.
com_pid: Process ID of the running server.
com_crashed: Set by the engine after a crash.
com_errormessage: Last error message the engine produced.
fs_copyfiles: Copy files from the read-only paths into the home path.
fs_restrict: Restrict the file system to shipped content.
fs_skipWorkshop: Ignore Steam Workshop content when loading files.
protocol: Network protocol version the server speaks.
gamedate: Build date of the game module.
arch: Platform the server binary was built for.
username: OS user the server process runs as.
timescale: Time multiplier. 1 is real time; other values only apply with cheats.
fixedtime: Run the simulation with a fixed frame time (debugging).
journal: Record or play back an engine journal (debugging).
ttycon: Use the terminal console on Linux.
pmove_AirControl: How much steering the player has in the air.
pmove_AirStopAccel: Acceleration applied when stopping in the air.
pmove_AirSteps: Air movement is stepped over small obstacles.
pmove_AutoHop: Holding jump keeps bunny hopping without re-pressing.
pmove_ChainJumpVelocity: Velocity granted by a chained jump.
pmove_CrouchSlideFriction: Friction applied during a crouch slide.
pmove_CrouchSlideTime: How long a crouch slide lasts.
pmove_JumpVelocityScaleAdd: Extra jump velocity added when scaling applies.
pmove_RampJumpScale: Velocity scaling applied to ramp jumps.
pmove_StepHeight: Height of a step the player can walk up.
pmove_StepJumpVelocity: Velocity granted by a step jump.
pmove_WishSpeed: Speed the movement code tries to reach.
pmove_WeaponDropTime: Milliseconds it takes to lower a weapon.
pmove_WeaponRaiseTime: Milliseconds it takes to raise a weapon.
bot_enable: Bots may be added to the server.
bot_minplayers: Bots are added until this many players are in the game.
bot_startingSkill: Skill level new bots start at.
bot_dynamicSkill: Bot skill adapts to the players.
bot_autoReady: Bots ready up automatically in warmup.
bot_grapple: Bots may use the grappling hook.
bot_teamkill: Bots may hurt their own team.
bot_itemDelayTime: Delay before bots go for an item.
g_voteFlags: Bitmask of callvote types to disable. Bits 1 (map) and 4 (nextmap) are coupled inside the client: deny either and the in-game vote menu loses its whole map section.
g_range_lg_falloff: Distance at which lightning gun damage starts falling off.
g_range_sg_falloff: Distance at which shotgun damage starts falling off.
g_ironsights_mg: Iron sights mode for the machine gun.
g_ammoPackHack: Legacy compatibility flag for ammo pack behaviour.
practiceflags: Bitmask of practice-mode options. Bit meanings are not verified.
zmq_rcon_enable: Enable the ZeroMQ remote console. It binds its own TCP port and cannot be turned on or off after launch.
zmq_rcon_ip: IP the ZeroMQ rcon socket binds to. Cannot change after launch.
zmq_rcon_port: TCP port for ZeroMQ rcon. Must differ from the stats port if both are used, and cannot change after launch.
zmq_rcon_password: Password for the ZeroMQ rcon socket. Unlike the port, this one can be changed after launch.
zmq_stats_enable: Enable the ZeroMQ stats socket, which streams match events to a listening client.
zmq_stats_ip: IP the ZeroMQ stats socket binds to.
zmq_stats_port: TCP port for the ZeroMQ stats socket. Defaults to the game server's own IP and port if left unset.
zmq_stats_password: Password for the ZeroMQ stats socket.
fs_homepath: Writable data directory the server reads and writes configs, plugins and downloads in.
fs_basepath: Read-only directory the base game data is installed in.
fs_game: Mod or game directory the server runs out of (normally baseq3).
cm_noAreas: Ignore area portals in the collision model (debugging).
cm_noCurves: Ignore curved surfaces in the collision model (debugging).
